edition_angle: Epigenetic constraint on neural plasticity and memory remodeling in the aging dentate gyrus

assignments.angle: Investigating how Suv39h1-mediated H3K9me3 accumulation in the aging dentate gyrus restricts activity-dependent synaptic remodeling and memory formation.
assignments.reason: This study provides a precise epigenetic mechanism (H3K9me3 accumulation driven by Suv39h1 in aged dentate gyrus neurons) that directly limits synaptic plasticity and memory, offering a novel target to restore cognitive resilience in aging.
